title: 2018 AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: Sam drove \(96\) miles in \(90\) minutes. His average speed during the first \(30\) minutes was \(60\) mph (miles per hour), and his average speed during the second \(30\) minutes was \(65\) mph. What was his average speed, in mph, during the last \(30\) minutes?

solutions.text:
In the first \(30\) minutes Sam covered \(60\cdot\tfrac12=30\) miles, and in the second he covered \(65\cdot\tfrac12=32.5\) miles.

The last \(30\) minutes covered \(96-30-32.5=33.5\) miles, so the speed was \[ \dfrac{33.5}{\frac{1}{2}}=67\text{ mph}. \]

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Find the distance covered in each of the first two \(30\)-minute segments
The remaining distance is covered in \(\tfrac12\) hour; divide to get the speed
